# rename to metadata.yaml. Defaults every mode gets; a document's own front matter wins.
documentclass: CLASSNAME
papersize: letter
indent: true                # Pandoc removes paragraph indents unless told otherwise
csl: STYLE.csl
colorlinks: false
mainfont: TeX Gyre Termes   # a font with a real bold (the automatic one has none for XeTeX/LuaTeX)
geometry: " "               # or the class's own geometry options; stops pdfmd's automatic margin
# no `lang:` if the class loads babel itself
